IsShared.rationale: multiplayer-only. EventModel.IsShared (EventModel.cs:80-85) has exactly three readers and all are multiplayer: the vote-vs-independent choice split in EventSynchronizer, the shared-event label (NEventLayout.cs:227, gated on `Players.Count > 1`), and the per-event Rng seed term `IsShared ? 0 : GetPlayerSlotIndex(Owner)` (EventModel.cs:238), which is 0 in single player either way -- rng.make_event_rng records exactly that reduction (rng.py:74-80). The fourth use is an assertion that only a shared event may call EnterCombatWithoutExitingEvent (EventModel.cs:610-613). Out of scope per the shared contract's multiplayer waiver.

AfterEventStarted.rationale: presentation only: PunchOff.cs:55-61 subscribes to RunManager's RoomExited and kicks off PunchEachOther (PunchOff.cs:63-99), an infinite anim/VFX/SFX loop -- TriggerAnim, PlayOnCreatureCenter, NHitSparkVfx, Cmd.Wait, a node Scale flip -- cancelled by a CancellationTokenSource on room exit (PunchOff.cs:138-142) or by TakeThem (PunchOff.cs:121). It deals no damage, applies no power and takes no stream draw; the two Creatures it animates are the display-only ones EV-12 covers.

guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 6): every event module is on its named stream. The mechanism's own executed probe (`py audit/tools/event_probes.py eventrng`) now reports **0 modules rolling only on the shared rng** where it reported 4. Three were real and are fixed: dense_vegetation's gold is `base.Rng.NextInt(61, 100)` (DenseVegetation.cs:37), punch_off's unused GoldVar is `base.Rng.NextInt(91, 99)` (PunchOff.cs:103) -- a draw that exists only to advance the stream -- and potion_courier's Ransack pick is `base.Owner.PlayerRng.Rewards.NextItem(items)` (PotionCourier.cs:52), the per-player Rewards stream rather than the event's own Rng. The fourth, wood_carvings, was a PROBE DEFECT, not a port defect: the probe counted any `run.transform_card(` as a draw, but Wood Carvings passes `into=` (C#'s `CardCmd.TransformTo<Peck>` / `<ToricToughness>`, WoodCarvings.cs:58,:83), which names the replacement and rolls nothing in either language. The probe also demanded the literal `event_rng`, so Potion Courier would still have read off-stream after being routed to the CORRECT named stream. Both were fixed in audit/tools/event_probes.py with the reasoning inline.  The text it replaced read: MECHANISM EV-3, one verdict at every site (rule 3). Each C# EventModel gets its own Rng seeded from the run seed + event id, and the sim already models it: Event.__init__ builds `self.event_rng` from make_event_rng(seed, ID) for string-seeded runs (events/base.py:84-88), and 6 modules branch on it. EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/event_probes.py eventrng`): 28 of the 34 event modules that roll anything roll ONLY on `self.rng`. LIVE for the parity path that the conformance harness grades -- a shared-rng draw both takes a number the game never takes off that stream and fails to advance the event stream, desyncing the rest of the run. In legacy (RL) mode both are the same random.Random, so the observable is parity-only -- which is an exercised sim mode, not an unreachable one.
